The profiler couldn't write its output inside the sandbox, so I'll time the two top-level pieces directly with an inline run that doesn't touch any files.
`countPrimes` is the slowest function in `scripts/slow.mjs`, taking about 458 ms versus about 53 ms for `dedupe`.

It spends its time in `isPrime` (lines 2–6), which trial-divides every number up to `n`, so the total work grows roughly with the square of the limit. `dedupe` is also quadratic (`out.includes` on line 14), but it runs over 30,000 values with only 9,000 unique ones, so it is much cheaper here.

Volt's CPU profiler couldn't write its output in the sandbox, so these timings come from an inline copy of the same functions rather than the profiler. I didn't change any files.
